fact: Internet Society Pulse, from self-reported PeeringDB data last updated January 2026, lists ADDIX in Addis Ababa with 3 members (AddIX Technology Solutions, Bank of Abyssinia, WebSprix), 21 Gbps cumulative port capacity, and all 3 peering at the route server.

Wingu Africa states that ADDIX, Ethiopia's first IXP, launched over a year before 4 September 2025 and is operated by ADDIX Technology Solutions under the Ethiopian Communications Authority, hosted at Wingu's data centre in the ICT Park, keeping local traffic in Ethiopia (as_of is the article date, which gives no launch date).
